title: Subqueries
explain: A subquery is a query inside another query. It can produce a single value to compare against, or a list to test membership with `IN`. Use one when the answer to the inner question is needed before the outer one can run.
exercise: Find the students who scored below the average of their own course.
tip: A subquery used with `=` must return exactly one value. If it can return several rows, use `IN` instead.
